hero.title: Custom Tailoring & Clothing Services
hero.description: Clothing made around your design, preferences and measurements in Kigali, Rwanda. Discuss a garment of your own, explore fabric options and request a personalised quotation.

scope.title: Your Garment. Your Starting Point.
scope.description: You can enquire directly without choosing a gallery design. Share what you would like made, the occasion and your preferred completion date; we assess the requirements before accepting an order.

items.title: Custom clothing & special requests
items.description: Discuss shirts, trousers, dresses, jackets, coats or another garment idea. A reference photograph helps explain the style; construction, materials and feasibility must be agreed individually.

items.title: Customer-supplied fabric
items.description: Have material you would like us to use? Ask about cut, make and trim (CMT): making an agreed garment using your fabric, subject to assessment and confirmation of the work and additional materials required.

preparation.title: Fabric, Measurements & Fittings
preparation.description: Start with the design, colour, feel and occasion you have in mind. Your fabric preference is a starting point for discussion, not confirmation of stock or suitability.
preparation.fabricTitle: Choose fabric or ask for guidance
preparation.fabricDescription: Explore the Fabric Guide, request help choosing, or tell us you will supply your own material. We confirm suitability and available options before agreeing the quotation.
preparation.measurementsDescription: You do not need final measurements to begin an enquiry. We discuss the measurements and fittings your garment needs; follow the guide or ask about an individually arranged visit.
preparation.ownFabricSummary: What happens if I supply the fabric?

process.title: From Your Idea to an Agreed Order

steps.title: Describe your garment
steps.description: Tell us the design, quantity, occasion, fabric preference and requested date. You can discuss reference pictures with the team.

steps.title: Agree the details
steps.description: We assess feasibility, materials, measurements and fittings, then confirm the proposed work, inclusions, price and completion arrangements in a quotation.

steps.title: Confirm the order
steps.description: Accept the quotation and complete its applicable payment and order requirements. An enquiry, payment screenshot or requested date does not confirm a production order.

steps.title: Fittings & handover
steps.description: Production follows the official start notice. Complete agreed fittings and payment, then confirm the collection or delivery arrangements for your garment.

conditions.title: Before You Confirm
conditions.description: Your quotation confirms the actual garment, materials, inclusions, applicable charges and completion date. These estimates do not guarantee acceptance of a requested deadline.

details.title: Production timing & the official start notice

suits.title: Looking for a Suit?
suits.description: Explore men's or women's suit categories, including the styles available for quotation. Choose a reference, then continue with your selections, quantities and fabric preference.

support.title: Guidance for Your Request
support.description: Read the applicable order conditions before confirming. Suit-package benefits and eligibility are explained separately; a reference image is not a promise of exact reproduction or stock.

final.title: Tell Us What You Would Like Made
final.description: Request a quotation directly or discuss your design on WhatsApp. Sending an enquiry does not confirm an order or a completion date.
